articleTitleZh: Agent 评测不能只交一个分数：把运行与评分变成可执行证据包
articleTitleEn: An Agent Evaluation Should Ship More Than a Score
coreProposition: A release-grade evaluation must expose both the agent execution chain and the evaluator execution chain as a reviewable evidence package; the aggregate score is only one small artifact inside that package.
visualMetaphor: Two materially distinct inspection tracks converge into one open evidence folio. A small score token sits inside the folio rather than dominating the image, showing that a score is a component of the package, not the package itself.
dominantSubject: An open, shallow archival folio on a bright laboratory worktable containing a scenario card, a folded trace ribbon, a calibrated test strip, a compact code cassette, several evidence tabs and a small circular result token, all without written language.
environment: Bright contemporary editorial studio-laboratory with an ivory seamless background and generous breathing room.

composition.foreground: A few crisp evidence tabs and the edge of the open folio create depth.
composition.midground: The folio is the clear focal point; a cobalt-blue action ribbon arrives from one side and an amber measurement ribbon arrives from the other, each passing through a small physical inspection gate before interlocking in the folio.
composition.background: Soft ivory field with faint embossed registration marks and long, clean daylight shadows; no scene clutter.
composition.framing: Wide 16:9 landscape, slight top-down three-quarter view, central focal cluster with safe margins for responsive crop.
composition.hierarchy: Evidence package first, two independent chains second, small score token third.

style: Tactile editorial still life combining premium paper engineering, matte ceramic, transparent acrylic and brushed aluminum; precise but humane, closer to a magazine science cover than a product interface.
lighting: Soft high-key morning studio light from upper left, controlled highlights, legible cast shadows, bright midtones.
palette: Warm ivory and pale sand base; cobalt and teal for the agent-run chain; amber and muted coral for the evaluator chain; charcoal used only for small structural details.
